subject.title: Crestodian treats installed but logged-out CLI as usable AI

question: Should this protected maintainer-labeled onboarding auth bug stay with maintainers, or should a maintainer explicitly promote a narrow ClawSweeper repair job?
rationale: The source path and expected fix are clear, but the protected label requires explicit maintainer handling before automation queues a repair.

options.title: Maintainer owns repair
options.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer to patch the detector and tests across Claude and Codex CLI auth checks.

options.title: Promote repair lane
options.body: A maintainer can explicitly promote a narrow ClawSweeper job for the same source path if they want automation to implement it.

recommendation.title: Maintainer owns repair
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open for a maintainer to patch the detector and tests across Claude and Codex CLI auth checks.

likelyOwner.reason: The current detector and Crestodian setup code are blamed to this recent feature work.
